verdict.rationale: Snowsight's Query History page lets you monitor queries from the last 14 days and drill into a query profile to explore each step of an executed query. That covers the core need of diagnosing why a query is slow. A community comment complains about weak query-level cost attribution, but that is an opinion about cost reporting, not a concrete failure of the query profile. missing for 10: in-depth docs on profile operators/statistics, EXPLAIN-style pre-execution plans, documented per-query cost attribution, independent hands-on corroboration.
